cameraPolicy: Same camera, pose and framing from 001 onward; no per-iteration auto-fit.
technique: Real Blender mesh, continuous voxel fusion, scripted anatomical sculpture and local mesh edits. No concept projection; no manual brush sculpting claim.

rejected.004: Facial vertical warp folded the mesh below the eyes.
rejected.006: Eye surface sampling hit the upper cheek and folded the cornea.

steps.005: Rebuild face proportions, not a vertical stretch.
steps.007: Separate upper cheek from lower eyelid; smaller mouth.
steps.010: Smaller roller, solid lathed guards/hubs, belly contact.
steps.011: Connect chest marking and preserve teal flippers.
steps.012: Lower flipper shoulders, broaden near tip.
steps.013: Shorter, wider tongue and shallower mouth.

limits: Not pixel-identical to the approved concept: silhouette, tail, flipper contour and facial expression still differ.
Artistic approval is not implied by a passed technical test.
Intermediate .blend caches stay local; sources, configs and production master reproduce the result.
